title: Understanding the Weather
text: The weather in my house depends on the sky. On Monday, it was cloudy and warm. My cat, Luna, jumped out of bed and played in the garden. We loved to play. On Tuesday, the sky was sunny and hot. It felt warm outside. I wore my sweater. The sun was very strong. We played in the grass for hours. On Wednesday, it was rainy. I wore my raincoat and hat. My shoes got wet quickly. My feet felt hot. I cleaned my hands after washing my face. My family stayed home because it was cold. I stayed in my room. It was quiet. The TV was on. We watched TV. It felt nice. On Thursday, the sky was clear and blue. It was the hottest day ever. I felt very hot. The wind blew. I felt cold. I made ice cream. We shared a big dinner. The moon was high. The stars appeared in the sky. We loved the night. I closed my eyes and slept well. It was peaceful. The clouds started to move. They rolled down the windows. It was windy. The rain stopped. It was sunny again. I felt comfortable. The flowers in the park are beautiful. I loved them. Today, I went to the library. The library is quiet. It is safe. I could read books. It was boring. But I liked the quiet. The books were on shelves. I read a story about a brave lion. It was exciting. I finished the story. I smiled. I felt happy. The sun began to set. The sky turned orange. I looked out the window. The flowers were full of red. The sunset was beautiful. I watched the sun go down. The birds sang. It was peaceful. I stayed in bed. The moon was low. The stars twinkle. It felt warm. I opened my eyes. It was cold. I needed to wear my coat. I felt tired. I slept again. The clouds moved again. The rain stopped. The wind stopped. It was sunny. The sun came up high. The sky was clear. The birds flew. It was happy. I looked out the window. The flowers were full of gold. The sunset was beautiful. I watched the sun set. The birds flew off. It was peaceful. questions.q: True or False: The sky changes every day because of the sun's position.
questions.explanation: The sun stays in the same place. The sky changes because of the weather.

questions.q: True or False: The weather depends on my mood.
questions.explanation: The weather depends on the sky. A happy mood helps feel better.

questions.q: True or False: It is okay to play outside on a rainy day.
questions.explanation: Playing outside on a rainy day can get wet and messy.

questions.sampleAnswer: I will tell you a fun fact about the weather.

questions.before: What is the main reason the weather changes in your house?
questions.answer: The weather is controlled by the sky.

vocabulary.definition: The state of the air and clouds. You can know it by the color of the sky or how it feels.
vocabulary.example: The weather changed from cloudy to sunny today.

vocabulary.definition: The large blue space above the ground. The sun sets here.
vocabulary.example: The stars appeared in the blue sky.

vocabulary.definition: Falls on the ground after it was warm.
vocabulary.example: The room got cooler as the sun went down.

vocabulary.definition: Feels warm on the body. You will feel hotter than in winter.
vocabulary.example: It was too hot to play in the grass.

vocabulary.definition: Feels like heat. You feel warmer when you are in the sun.
vocabulary.example: The room was warm inside the house.
